say:1:1530118501:1.text: Uh... the goddess never said, and I didn't ask.
say:1:1530118501:1.male: Uh... the goddess never said, and I didn't ask.
say:1:1530118501:1.female: Uh... the goddess never said, and I didn't ask.

say:2:1530118502:1.text: But it's enough to deal with those hairless apes!
say:2:1530118502:1.source_cn: 但是对付那群没毛的猿人肯定够了！
say:2:1530118502:1.male: But it's enough to deal with those hairless apes!
say:2:1530118502:1.female: But it's enough to deal with those hairless apes!

say:3:1530118503:1.text: Let them come! I'll make them tremble before me!
say:3:1530118503:1.source_cn: 让那些家伙等着瞧吧，可别被我的威风吓得瑟瑟发抖了！
say:3:1530118503:1.male: Let them come! I'll make them tremble before me!
say:3:1530118503:1.female: Let them come! I'll make them tremble before me!
